I'd like to see this functionality applied to the blue crystal 'busy downloading' placeholders as well.
I think this functionality should be implemented along with an option for users to customize the 'extent' to which it's applied. For example: 
Enabled: Placeholder avatar height is fully scaled. 
Limited: Placeholder avatar height is scaled but the maximum and minimum size is clamped between 30 cm (~1 ft) and 3 m (~10 ft). 
Disabled: Placeholder avatar height is not scaled.
I imagine this could be done without the client even needing to first download the avatar. If the VRChat servers stored metadata about avatars such as the bounding box size or the Y coordinate of the View Position, then this could be sent to the client so that the client wouldn't need to download the avatar in order to evaluate its size before replacing it with a scaled placeholder.
Available to test in open beta !
